audit_mode: Read-only inspection and saved-data arithmetic. No new quantum calculation, training, PDE/MD/SSA simulation or eigenproblem.
selector_convention: JSON pointers follow RFC6901, including ~1 for slash in dictionary keys. CSV filters are exact string equality; csv_line includes one header row. Numeric CSV fields remain lossless source strings.

evidence_categories.derived_analysis: Saved-data error decomposition or parameterized nuclear calculation

proposed_manuscript_axis: Hierarchical verification with matched counterexamples and error attribution. H2 is the deep quantum-to-surrogate-to-nuclear case; remaining modules are bounded supporting cases, not one validated end-to-end catalyst platform.

modules.title: Original five-task demonstration
negative_results: Single noisy BO campaign lacks an executed random comparator. In-sample regression/classification scores do not measure generalization.
Catalyst ordering is assigned, not calculated from transition states; source flow units and narrative are inconsistent.
modules.allowable_conclusion: Software demonstration and source-audit case only; no chemical optimization, mechanism, selectivity or experimental validation.

Catalyst score perturbations per noise level

quantitative_evidence.value: 10,000 independent lognormal k1 and k2 draws, log-SD 0.2; these are scenario intervals, not experimental confidence intervals.

negative_results: Scaled versus original GP paired interval contains zero. Linear model beats gradient boosting on the synthetic test generator.
Near-boundary classification deteriorates; assigned catalyst ranking is noise-sensitive.
Fixed-neutral-nuclei xTB charge differences include state-specific ALPB response; they are not calibrated oxidation potentials, DFT barriers, or experimental regioselectivity.
modules.allowable_conclusion: Methodological controls on known synthetic functions and bounded semiempirical descriptors; no discovery claim.

modules.title: Production pipeline audit
negative_results: Source SASA failed; executable repair and explicit radii do not validate a catalytic mechanism.
No established physical-embedding advantage; scaled one-hot GP has higher mean regret than random in this pool.
C3 selectivity and the synthetic size-effect regression lack mechanistic labels.
modules.allowable_conclusion: Executed audit, geometry/descriptor calculations, and ODE consistency; no transition-state or experimental selectivity evidence.

modules.title: Multi-objective scope and spherical transport
negative_results: Source performs enumeration rather than Bayesian optimization; later GP is retrospective.
Gasteiger charges are graph-based and unchanged across conformers; seeded scope yields are synthetic.
Source assertion that effectiveness falls below 0.4 above 50 micrometres is false under its parameters.
modules.allowable_conclusion: Bounded Pareto/transport verification and semiempirical descriptors; no validated molecular-scope or porous-catalyst synthesis prediction.

modules.title: Closed-loop planning and stoichiometry
negative_results: Six historical labels are mock values; low source residual is not prospective performance.
Reviewed GP LOOCV MAE remains worse than the mean baseline.
Twelve DFT input files were generated, not executed; SOP needs verified product, reaction stoichiometry, quench and assay.
modules.allowable_conclusion: Auditable planning and input generation only; no wet-lab closed loop, measured yield, or completed DFT.

modules.title: Analytical parsing and publication toolkit
negative_results: HPLC fixture gives 1292 percent yield and fails plausibility; displayed NMR agreement cannot repair incompatible calibrations.
Area recovery is excellent only when the Gaussian width assumption is correct; wrong widths produce about 14.6 percent mean error.
Original threshold plot misses all 23 actual nondominated points; no raw vendor HPLC/FID ingestion or chemical validation.
modules.allowable_conclusion: Parser, recovery and graphic-method controls. The HPLC and NMR examples are not experimental measurements.

modules.title: ElectraTwin source and reviewed single-reaction transport
negative_results: Source fixed 12-condition grid does not execute EHVI; unclipped FE exceeds 100 percent and current/mass flux disagree.
Original eight-seed paired HV interval includes zero; FE is fixed by a single-reaction electron identity.
Hydraulic/thermal estimates are not CFD, measured thermal control, full PMI or industrial validation.
modules.allowable_conclusion: Conservative model implementation and bounded optimizer benchmark. Reviewed 121 PDE solves = 39 verification + 81 pool + one separate baseline; tests/source excluded.

modules.title: Competing-reaction, sensitivity and optimizer extensions

value.method: Resample matched row indices simultaneously across A, B and every AB_i; reestimate pooled variance each time.
value.interpretation: Exploratory paired-row resampling stability only. Rows of a scrambled QMC net are not iid; this bootstrap destroys its balance and is not a rigorous QMC confidence interval. No independent scrambling replicates were run.

negative_results: Near-machine charge closure coexists with 11.387 percent net-product FE; gross formation charge fraction must not be reported as net FE.
Sobol first-order estimate can exceed its total-order estimate at finite sample size; paired QMC bootstrap intervals are sensitivity diagnostics.

Optimization and sensitivity retain the old single-reaction pool and are not coupled to the new four-species network. Expanded campaigns reproduce the original 240-prefix uses, so those are not independent additions.
GP loses to quadratic regression in blocked holdouts, despite positive fixed-pool final-budget HV advantage over random.
modules.allowable_conclusion: Conditional effects inside explicit uncalibrated models; extension PDE total 1892 = 63 network/reference + 1829 sensitivity. Optimizer evidence is limited to one frozen 81-point pool.

negative_results: Two of three real-label MPNN seeds lose to descriptor ridge on the same 51-molecule test set; neither GP representation improves over the other in eight paired final budgets.

FreeSolv hydration labels are not oxidation potentials, atom Fukui labels, or chemical reaction yields. Acyclic structures are grouped individually; this is not a strict novel-scaffold generalization claim.
Pilot evaluated the same heldout molecules. Main validation-only checkpoint selection does not make the entire development process test-blind.
Source six selected atoms are hydrogen and random priorities can recover the full six; source reaction C22H21NOS to C21H17NOS loses C1H4 and has no atom mapping.
Source versus reviewed SASA/Rg comparisons change geometry, radii and ensemble; they are not a pure metric-controlled comparison.
Kinetics is an assumed independent-site state model; steady expected TOF ceiling is not a bound on every finite stochastic estimate.
modules.allowable_conclusion: Supervised hydration benchmark, molecular geometry controls and exact-model kinetic verification. No validated electrochemical atom ranking, catalytic mechanism or experimental rate prediction.

quantitative_evidence.label: /limits
value: FCI is exact only within the chosen finite one-electron basis and electronic Hamiltonian.
Small learning error against RHF does not remove its electronic approximation error.
Signed cancellation can reduce total error accidentally; no FCI labels entered training.

negative_results: Six pilot configurations were rejected before the energy driver, not six failed quantum calculations; all 203 actual extension drivers converged.
FCI is exact only within each finite one-electron basis; UHF has substantial spin contamination at stretch, and finding a lower branch is not proof of the global Hartree-Fock minimum.

Energy-force neural training improves paired reference fit but cannot remove reference RHF bias. Validation for both losses used gradient information. All neural test energies are worse than the frozen RBF baseline.
The 126 error rows comprise only 21 unique geometries; matched OOD has five of the original nine OOD distances.
Morse is fixed from actual FCI minimum, curvature and dissociation reference, not fitted as the full FCI potential. Its global residual is material.
Tiny tridiagonal residuals do not guarantee converged vibrational observables or a correct near-threshold level count. Finest tail still has 1.564 percent relative error in the shallow-state binding.
Full-line analytic Morse levels and radial half-line numerical levels have distinct boundaries; reported bound-only J=0 partition is not a complete gas-phase Gibbs or reaction free energy.
modules.allowable_conclusion: Deep matched-reference case: finite-basis electronic bias, learned-reference error and nuclear discretization error can be separately diagnosed. No complete-basis, experimental spectroscopy or novel electronic-structure theory claim.

paired_counterexamples.statement: Accurate learned-reference fit cannot remove the reference electronic-structure bias.
paired_counterexamples.matching: same H2 geometry, basis, objective, seed and point_id
paired_counterexamples.scope: 126 model rows, 21 unique geometries; 8 interpolation-test and 5 matched OOD distances; exact signed identity, not a theorem about additive RMSE. Root manuscript analysis supplies any new RMSE cross-term decomposition.

paired_counterexamples.statement: A tiny eigenproblem residual coexists with inaccurate nuclear observables.
paired_counterexamples.matching: same FCI_cc-pvdz-derived Morse H2 model, [0,8] angstrom domain and 1200 intervals
paired_counterexamples.scope: Matrix residual verifies the discretized operator; grid and domain error are distinct. Full-line comparison requires explicit half-line boundary limitation.

paired_counterexamples.statement: Equivariance does not ensure OOD superiority to a simple baseline.
paired_counterexamples.matching: same trained synthetic-shape EGNN seed 4441; covariance probe and frozen warped-shape test
paired_counterexamples.scope: Synthetic geometry only; model is matched but covariance and OOD probes are different inputs.

paired_counterexamples.statement: Charge conservation does not imply high target-product selectivity.
paired_counterexamples.scope: Charge relative error 1.8917e-15 and net product FE 11.3871 percent coexist; this demonstrates a model identity versus an output, not experimental accuracy failure.

paired_counterexamples.statement: Excellent transformed regression fit can coexist with an invalid BET-window diagnostic.
paired_counterexamples.matching: same rounded synthetic isotherm fit with requested 0.10 to 0.35 relative-pressure window
paired_counterexamples.scope: R2=0.9999999977651836, monolayer pressure=0.08530837788716895 outside window; not a complete BET validity assessment.

paired_counterexamples.statement: Improved energy error need not improve derivative error.
paired_counterexamples.matching: same eight H2 RHF test distances and reviewed RBF model family
paired_counterexamples.scope: Joint RBF energy RMSE improves 8.6243e-6 to 5.5614e-6 Hartree while gradient RMSE worsens 1.1562e-4 to 1.6375e-4 Hartree/angstrom. This is distinct from paired neural results where both metrics improve.

audit_findings.finding: No universal total-calculation count is scientifically meaningful across driver calls, optimizer steps, MD time steps, stochastic events, grid nodes and cached evaluations.
audit_findings.action: Keep a multidimensional workload ledger; pilots and tests are explicitly separate.

audit_findings.finding: ElectroGraph and SynthaPore pilots assessed the same final heldout datasets.
audit_findings.action: State validation-only checkpoint selection for main runs, but do not claim the whole development was heldout-blind; count repeated rows only as repeated evaluations.

audit_findings.finding: External experimental FreeSolv labels are used even though this work performed no new wet-lab experiments.
audit_findings.action: Distinguish reused experimental dataset from new measurements.

audit_findings.finding: ElectraTwin 4800 expanded cached uses reproduce 240 original prefix records.
audit_findings.action: Do not call 5040 uses independent experiments, and do not call cached uses new PDE solves.

audit_findings.finding: Original and reviewed ElectroGraph target SASA/Rg use different geometries, radii and ensemble policies.
audit_findings.action: Do not attribute their full difference solely to one radius or mass-weighting change.

audit_findings.finding: Toolkit NMR 91.392 percent uses rounded source amount, while 91.3252869 percent recomputes amount from mass.
audit_findings.action: Label the inputs; this difference is not an arithmetic contradiction.

audit_findings.finding: The matched H2 error decomposition contains five OOD distances while the model benchmark contains nine.
audit_findings.action: Always attach matched-subset size; never compare its metrics to full-OOD metrics without labeling.

audit_findings.finding: Original chemical graphs, unconstrained charges, singular overlaps, arbitrary energy units and incompatible thermochemical references invalidate source physical conclusions.
audit_findings.action: Preserve failure evidence rather than treating executable repairs as chemical validation.

audit_findings.finding: The evidence supports a cross-layer verification and error-attribution study, not invention of FCI, EGNN, NEB, Morse, GP-UCB or finite-volume methods.
audit_findings.action: Frame innovation as a reproducible matched counterexample/diagnostic protocol and test its incremental scientific utility; do not assert literature priority without a dedicated review.

audit_findings.finding: Three neural seeds, finite deterministic splits and assumed QMC perturbation distributions do not support broad population or physical-uncertainty claims.
audit_findings.action: Report paired seed sensitivity, fixed-pool limits and assumed-distribution intervals explicitly.

xTB.scope: Run records; no DFT or experiment implied.

Psi4_energy_drivers.scope: FCI internally solves its reference SCF; those SCF messages are not extra energy-driver jobs. Original analytic gradient calls are a separate workload.

ElectraTwin_PDE.scope: Numerically different solve categories; source runs and unit-test solves excluded. Cached optimizer uses are separate.

nuclear_eigenproblems.scope: Distinct discretized eigenproblems, not unique physical molecules or electronic structure jobs.

homogeneous_job_accounting.grand_total_reason: Heterogeneous units cannot be added into a physically interpretable calculation count.

catalog_internal_verification.verification_scope: Existence, SHA256, exact JSON-pointer/CSV source selection and saved-row counts; not a re-execution of scientific solvers.

manuscript_posthoc_independent_review.review_mode: Read source script; independently recompute from frozen CSV with Python standard-library csv/math.fsum. Do not invoke analysis main(), scientific solvers, training or eigenproblem code.
checks: Frozen replay drift is zero; two-term MSE identity is applicable.
The missing-state 12 angstrom row has no falsely assigned shallow-state error or ratio.
96 angstrom Richardson value uses exactly two saved grids; no new eigenproblem.
Negative cross terms denote cancellation and are not positive variance fractions.

manuscript_body_review.finding: No blocking scientific misstatement identified in current body; bibliography, figures and publication readiness are outside this narrow review.
